description: List WEEEK tasks with server-side filters: project, board, column, assignee (userId), completion, free-text `search`, priority, type, a single `day` or a startDate–endDate range (dd.mm.yyyy), completion dates. Set allPages=true together with userId, startDate, and endDate to fetch every matching page inside the connector without returning unrelated workspace pages.

all.description: Include completed and deleted tasks; when set, `completed` is ignored.

search.description: Text to find in titles and descriptions.

name: weeek_list_tasks
